title: rostraria neglecta
intro: Rostraria neglecta, commonly known as False Oat-grass, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, stress, and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Rostraria neglecta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its calming and sedative effects. While further research is needed, the bioactive constituents of Rostraria neglecta suggest its potential as a natural remedy for promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality.
